title: Verify CRM login page loads with authentication form
expected_result: Login view displays with email and password input fields; app view is hidden.

title: Verify Invalid Credentials error handling
steps: 1. Enter non-existent email or wrong password. 2. Click Увійти.
expected_result: Authentication fails; displays error message Помилка with Firebase error details.

title: Verify Successful Admin Login with Firebase Auth
steps: 1. Enter valid admin email & password. 2. Click Увійти.
expected_result: Authenticates with Firebase Auth; CRM Dashboard displays with tabs and data loaded.

title: Verify Tab Navigation (Dashboard, Specialists, Emails, Applications, Archived, Feedback)
expected_result: Correct tab content displays; previous tab content is hidden; active tab is highlighted.

title: Verify Dashboard Statistics display
expected_result: Statistics cards show: Total Specialists, Pending Applications, Rejected Applications, Emails count.

title: Verify Specialists Table rendering with pagination
expected_result: Table loads specialists from Firestore with status=approved; displays name, category, location, contact buttons.

title: Verify Add New Specialist Modal opens with empty fields
expected_result: Modal appears with title Новий спеціаліст; all input fields are empty and ready for data entry.

title: Verify Edit Specialist Modal with pre-populated data
steps: 1. Click edit button on a specialist card.
expected_result: Modal opens with title Редагувати; all fields are populated with existing specialist data (name, category, phone, email, etc.).

title: Verify Save Changes to Specialist updates Firestore
steps: 1. Modify specialist details (name, phone, description). 2. Click Зберегти.
expected_result: Changes are saved to Firestore document; table updates immediately with new values.

title: Verify Delete Specialist with confirmation
steps: 1. Click delete/reject button on a specialist. 2. Confirm deletion.
expected_result: Specialist is removed from active list and archived; changes persist in Firestore.

title: Verify Applications Queue (Pending) rendering
expected_result: Displays all Firestore documents with status=pending; shows applicant details and action buttons.

title: Verify Approve Application changes status to approved
steps: 1. Click Підтвердити (Approve) on a pending application.
expected_result: Status in Firestore updates to approved; specialist card appears in Catalog after sync; application removed from pending queue.

title: Verify Reject Application with reason and email notification
steps: 1. Click Відхилити (Reject). 2. Select/type rejection reason. 3. Confirm.
expected_result: Status updates to rejected; EmailJS sends rejection notification to applicant; application moves to rejected view.

title: Verify Emails inbox loads from API endpoint
expected_result: Displays list of emails from /api/emails endpoint; shows sender, subject, date, unread count badge.

title: Verify Archived Specialists viewing
expected_result: Displays specialists from Firestore archived_specialists collection with read-only view (no edit buttons).

title: Verify Feedback & Error Reports viewing
expected_result: Lists all user feedback and bug reports from Firestore feedback collection with timestamps and category tags.

title: Verify Search/Filter in Specialists Table
steps: 1. Type specialist name or city in search box.
expected_result: Table updates in real-time filtering only matching records.

title: Verify Logout functionality
expected_result: Firebase session terminates; login form displayed; localStorage auth token cleared.

title: Verify Firebase Offline Error Handling
steps: 1. Block Firebase URLs / disconnect network. 2. Try to load data or save changes.
expected_result: Displays user-friendly error message; does not crash application.
